name: Higuchi Saeri
source:
Saeri first met the protagonist at a doujinshi convention while working for a rival employer. After encountering him, she felt an attraction to his zeal and personality, and sought to be in his employment. Saeri’s experience, willingness to make sacrifices, and positive attitude quickly earns the protagonist’s trust, and thus she becomes the cornerstone to his business success. She is selfless, and asks for nothing in return.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
